claims.claim: Geovany Andres Rojas, known as Araña or The Spider, was flown to California and placed in federal custody.
claims.episode_span: placed him in the custody of federal agents
claims.source_title: Accused drug lord known as "The Spider" extradited to California from Colombia
claims.supporting_quote: A Colombian warlord, whose extradition to the United States had been delayed for several months while he was designated a peace negotiator by the country's previous government, was flown to California and placed in custody of federal agents.

claims.claim: Rojas faces drug trafficking and terrorism charges in the United States and led Comandos de la Frontera in Putumayo.
claims.episode_span: He faces drug-trafficking and terrorism charges
claims.source_title: Accused drug lord known as "The Spider" extradited to California from Colombia
claims.supporting_quote: Geovany Andres Rojas faces drug trafficking and terrorism charges in the United States.

claims.claim: Rojas was arrested in Bogotá in February 2025, the Supreme Court approved extradition in October, and Gustavo Petro suspended it for peace talks.
claims.source_title: Accused drug lord known as "The Spider" extradited to California from Colombia
claims.supporting_quote: Rojas was arrested in Bogota in February 2025, and Colombia's Supreme Court approved his extradition to the U.S. in October.

claims.claim: President Abelardo de la Espriella lifted the extradition ban, supervised the transfer on Friday, and said peace is not built by protecting narco-terrorists.
claims.episode_span: You don't build peace by protecting narco-terrorists like this bandit
claims.source_title: Accused drug lord known as "The Spider" extradited to California from Colombia
claims.supporting_quote: "You don't build peace by protecting narco-terrorists like this bandit," De la Espriella said on Friday, after he personally supervised Rojas' transfer to the U.S.

claims.claim: In Rio's Complexo da Maré, police arrested eight suspects, six people were wounded, and one officer was shot, with about 200 officers deployed.
claims.episode_span: Eight suspects were arrested, six people were wounded, and one officer was shot.
claims.source_title: Operação na Maré tem seis feridos, oito presos e policial baleado
claims.supporting_quote: Oito suspeitos foram presos, seis pessoas ficaram feridas e um agente foi baleado.

claims.claim: Police in the Maré operation seized 12 rifles and five pistols and found grenades and drugs not yet counted.

claims.source_title: Operação na Maré tem seis feridos, oito presos e policial baleado
claims.supporting_quote: Foram apreendidos 12 fuzis e cinco pistolas.
